cues.text: Your team can’t be at every table, every minute.
Guests scan the QR on their table…
…and see your full menu, with prices, options and your guest favourites.
They order in a few taps…
…and it lands live on your team’s screen, in Bangla or English.
While they wait, guests can join your stamp card. Every served order earns a stamp.
Need a server, or the bill? One tap, and your team gets the request.
Your staff see every table, every request and every open bill in one place.
And you see what’s selling, when you’re busy, and how fast every table is served.
It works alongside your POS, payments stay with you, and you print your QR codes once.
This is TableMate, built by Zavino.
One system for your guests, your team, and you.
DM us to book a demo.
